digest.component_or_area: plan-review criterion registration and pass-1 container execution
propositions: Plan-review currently lacks a criterion that owns whether a ticket's own acceptance criteria and Scope/Out-of-Scope declarations are jointly satisfiable, allowing contradictions to surface only at verification or implementation time.

A new 1-TURN criterion `ac-satisfiability` (facet `coherence`, advisory posture 0.95) must detect three shapes of set-quantification contradiction: universal-vs-carve-out, derived-artifact closure, and snapshot cardinality.

The sibling roster sent to G3 currently contains only child ids and titles, preventing G3 from discharging its check that the union of siblings covers each parent AC; it must be enriched with each child's acceptance-criteria items extracted via `evaluate_plan_clarity().ac_items`.

Three independent copies of roster-building logic exist across pass1.py, fidelity_spot_eval.py, and eval_solver.py; they must be unified into a single shared `build_sibling_roster` helper to prevent eval harnesses from diverging on data used for dogfooding G3's deferred posture decision.

The roster must be moved from per-pairing instructions into the system prompt (as a byte-stable prefix component) so it is sent once rather than repeated per pairing, and its token cost must be included in the `parent_tokens` estimate that governs bin-packing and the warm gate.
